title: Pipeline steps run simultaneously and each gets the initial input
prompt: The import pipeline is a waterfall: step 2 must see step 1's output. Since a speed-things-up change all steps start at once and each receives the ORIGINAL input, so the importer never sees the loader's normalized rows. lib/waterfall.mjs documents the contract: run tasks one at a time in order, pass each task the previous task's return value (the first task gets initial), resolve with all results in order, and never start a task after one failed. Fix lib/waterfall.mjs and verify with your own script (start order, result chaining, abort on failure, empty input) before answering.
